name: PUBH 5407
title: Practicum in Public Health
description: Under faculty guidance, students undertake an organized set of activities that responds to an identified need of a public health agency or health-related organization. The activities may involve the policy development, planning, implementation, administration or evaluation of public health services, or a combination of such activities. Students should be appropriately advanced before initiating the practicum. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Four foundational courses from PUBH 5403, 5404, 5405, 5406, 5408, or 5409. Recommended preparation: PUBH 5431.
